fields.description: Program Description Program Introduction Shanghai University is a comprehensive University featured in China’s national Double First-Class Initiative and the 211 Project. With over six decades of experience educating international students, it offers a highly globalized campus environment, distinguished faculty, a full spectrum of academic disciplines, and a well-established support system for international learners. The Pre-University program is a non-degree undergraduate preparatory Program for International Students offered by the College of International Education of Shanghai University. This program boosts international students’ Chinese competence and builds solid foundations in science and engineering, Humanities, Economics & Management. It helps students meet Chinese University undergraduate admission standards and transition smoothly into Shanghai University’s undergraduate studies. Course Content and Tracks (Humanities, Economics & Management) Course Schedule Tuition Fee: CNY 26,000 per semester *Note: The above fee covers tuition, CSCA test preparation, HSK mock tests, and undergraduate application guidance fees.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. High school diploma or equivalent qualification certificate. Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 2. High school academic transcript Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 3. Statement of financial support The sponsor cannot be the applicant himself or a certain type of scholarship; The statement needs to be hand-signed and cannot be electronic signature; You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. HSK 3 over 180 score or above (scan or screenshot), issued within the last two years. * 5. No criminal record commitment * 6. Study plan * 7. A valid ordinary passport with at least one year of remaining validity. * 8. ID photo, recent color photograph taken within the last six months. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.High school diploma or equivalent qualification. 2. Non-Chinese citizens holding a valid ordinary foreign passport, in compliance with the relevant regulations of the Chinese Ministry of Education, including the “Document No.12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC” and etc. 3. Applicants must be in good physical and mental health, have no criminal record, and satisfy the medical examination standards for international students in China. 4. Applicants must between 16 and 24 years old, inclusive. 5. Generally, applicants should hold an HSK Level 3 over 180 score or above, or equivalent. *Note: Applicants who have not yet met the language requirement but intend to pursue Pre-University studies may be considered on a case-by-case basis.
